purpose: The standard every THEORY capability record must follow so the Theory Capability gate can call it as a research ACTION (not a knowledge point). The B-side cleans/curates the theory capability library to this schema; the in-source base library (argus_skill/verticals/physics/capabilities/theory.json) conforms to it as the reference example.
gate_checking_philosophy: The gate does NOT check for a fixed theoretical structure.
It checks: did Argus judge whether the capability is applicable?
If applicable, did Argus execute it?
If executed, is there artifact evidence?
If not executed, is the reason recorded?
If a claim depends on it but it was not done, is the claim downgraded?

required_fields.description: Short human name of the research action.
Domain / subdomain the capability belongs to ('*' for generic).
The question that decides WHEN this capability applies to a task.
The condition(s) under which it does NOT apply (so 'not used' can be legitimate).
The question that decides whether Argus actually USED this capability.
Where is the evidence file that shows it was executed?
The minimum acceptable artifact that proves basic execution.
The higher-quality artifacts that prove strong execution.
The gate failure code(s) raised when the capability is missing or done poorly.
How a dependent claim must be downgraded if the capability was needed but not done.
How the theoretical treatment must be compared to the closest prior theoretical treatment.
A concrete example of good use.
A concrete example of bad / superficial use.

gate_binding.note: Each capability's applicability_question/usage_question/evidence_question/claim_downgrade_if_missing map to the audit columns is_applicable/used_by_argus/evidence_file/claim_downgrade_if_missing that the gate verifies.
